description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {3}. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Tatterkite and the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Repeat.
